component.name: Condenser
component.summary: Cut clips from Steam game recordings

description.p: Condenser turns hours of Steam background recordings into short clips. It opens on your most recent session in a big player, so finding a moment and exporting it takes seconds.

ul.li: Browse full sessions and Steam's saved clips side by side
Preview frames while hovering the timeline, and zoom in to find the exact moment
Mark a start and end, drag them to fine-tune, and export only that part
Export without re-encoding, or as H.264, HEVC or AV1 on the GPU (VA-API)
See where the recording froze because the game was in the background

description.p: Steam's own exporter can't re-encode on AMD and Intel GPUs on Linux; Condenser uses FFmpeg with VA-API instead.
Condenser is a fork of Pineapple Steam Recording Exporter by Gary "BLumia" Wang. It adds the editor, full background sessions, GPU export formats and timeline previews.
Condenser is not affiliated with Valve. Steam is a trademark of Valve Corporation.

screenshot.caption: A session in the editor, with a clip marked on the timeline

description.p: First Condenser release, forked from Pineapple Steam Recording Exporter 0.6.0.

ul.li: Editor as the main screen, opening on the most recent session
Full background sessions next to Steam's saved clips
Zoomable timeline with hover previews and draggable clip markers
Export to H.264, HEVC or AV1 on the GPU, with a bitrate slider
Frozen stretches marked on the timeline
